html:
The Wakaya are an Aboriginal people of the eastern Barkly Tableland in the Northern Territory, near the border with Queensland.

Their neighbours on the map were the Wambaya to the west, the Warumungu to the southwest and the Alyawarr to the south. The open grasslands of their country were taken over by large cattle stations from the 1880s. Few people speak the Wakaya language today. See Aboriginal Australian societies.
sum: The Wakaya are an Aboriginal people of the eastern Barkly Tableland in the Northern Territory, near the border with Queensland.
